messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to debug a deployed app that run successfully on local machine?
parts: Sometimes you can see whether your instance is running out of memory if you look at the javascript console.  I would update the instance size up to a higher size and see if you continue to have the issue you are seeing.   If you include a link to the application, it might be possible for us to see the issue through the javascript console.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to debug a deployed app that run successfully on local machine?
parts: You can change the instance size in the dashboard of shiny apps.io under your application settings.
On Monday, September 28, 2015, Jianling peng <jlpe...@gmail.com> wrote:

I have the same issue, the app works fine in my local machine, also it is deployed successfully on the shinyapp.io sever. However, a few second later, the screen grays out. How did you change the instance size? I tried to change using command rsconnect::configureApp("APPNAME", size="large"), it gave me errors message, Error: attempt to apply non-function.


On Tuesday, July 7, 2015 at 7:04:17 PM UTC-5, Komal Rathi wrote:
Hi,

I created an R shiny application and it runs perfectly on my local machine. Also it is deployed successfully on the shinyapps.io server. 

However when I try to click one of the buttons to perform a task, the screen grays out (hangs). The same task is completed when I run my app locally. I can't see where the error lies because it is successfully run on my local machine. Any ideas how I can debug this?
